headlines.description: Prosecutors in Mecklenburg County, N.C., announced Tuesday they are dropping a criminal charge against Rep.-elect LaKesha Womack (D-N.C.) related to an un-returned rental car in 2019. Why it matters: The charge had been a bothersome footnote for Womack since her sudden rise from obscurity on Election Day, when she unexpectedly won a heavily Republican district.

sources.title: Trump’s intervention at Nvidia just gave Democrats another 2028 target
sources.description: For Democrats eyeing the White House , President Donald Trump’s coziness with tech executives was already a potent target even before he successfully pressured Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive. sources.name: Oregon Public Broadcasting
sources.title: Who really owns the land in Albania that Jared Kushner wants to develop?
sources.description: In the summer of 2021, Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump boarded a yacht owned by Nat Rothschild, an heir to the European banking family. On the way from Montenegro to Greece, the yacht anchored off the coast of Albania. And, as Kushner told an investment conference last year, that’s when Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama arrived at the boat to tell them about his plan for the country.
